# SwiftHerb

What this is
SwiftHerb helps people browse vitamins and supplements sold on iHerb. You can use a chat assistant to get ideas, read short articles, skim a category catalog, and open brand overview pages. We are a discovery site, not a clinic. Nothing here replaces advice from your doctor or pharmacist.

Who it is for
Adults in the United States and other countries where iHerb ships, who want a quicker way to narrow options before they read labels and reviews on the retailer site.

How links work
Buttons that send you to iHerb may use affiliate tracking so the project can earn a small commission if you buy. The price you pay on iHerb is the same as if you went there directly. Current details are always on the Affiliate Disclosure page.

Trust and limits
Editorial pages explain how we think about accuracy and disclosures. The chat uses an AI model; it can be wrong. Check supplement facts, allergens, drug interactions, and official reviews on iHerb before you order.

Crawling
Public HTML is meant to be indexed. Paths that look like APIs or build internals are blocked in robots.txt.
